def: roving (as a tramp), i.e. (by implication) an impostor or misleader;

occurrences.text: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
